prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production artwork for the Mars combination game, in the established realistic painterly retro-industrial style: cream factory equipment, muted teal habitat fittings, cobalt scientific fittings, mustard mobility accents, ochre Martian terrain, modest wear. Local construction is simple cut and bolted straight steel, cloth and foil; imported pressure vessels and instruments retain their precision. No people, lettering, captions, labels, numbers, border graphics or UI. Generate COMPLETE SCENES, not isolated items. Every state has the exact SAME CAMERA, perspective, geography, light, object size and position. Change ONLY the named construction state. Leave generous quiet foreground for movable supplies. The lower half is simple natural ground or floor, not extra equipment. These paintings will be registered and cropped into background and changing fixed objects. Recurring items must retain their exact design. Reference images establish design and style, not an invitation to add all their objects.
Create a single scene-state sheet: 2 equal portrait panels in one row. Each panel is a tall full game scene. Arrange states in reading order.
SCENE: View into a broad low cave from its open entrance, ochre rock around a stable roof, sunlit entrance foreground. The workable bay occupies the upper middle of the portrait; the lower half is clear red ground for the movable excavator and supplies. This is clearing loose ground, not excavating an unsupported tunnel.
STATE 1: The surveyed cave bay contains shallow loose infill and scattered manageable stones, with an obvious flat stable rock ceiling. No machinery or planted room.
STATE 2: Exactly the same cave and camera. The infill has been graded away to a level bare growing bay. A small spoil pile remains outside the working area. No new room, floor tiles or excavator in the painting.
